verdict.rationale: Bolt lets users select Supabase during project creation to get a hosted SQL database, auth, and edge functions directly within the builder, without leaving the tool (bolt-docs-8, bolt-docs-22, bolt-docs-27). However, this is an outsourced third-party integration rather than a native database, and community feedback notes friction (token exhaustion and errors after adding a database) and skepticism about the depth of this 'shortcut' approach (bolt-comm-4, bolt-comm-11).
